github.description: Tessera: a DIY Stream Deck alternative for 7-inch ESP32-P4 touchscreens. Boards: GUITION JC1060P470C and Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 7.0, plus experimental builds for Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-7 and Sunton ESP32-8048S070. Open-source macro deck with widgets, PC gauges, an AI agents screen and a Windows and Linux (X11) host. Home Assistant in beta
